collaborating with cross-functional leadership to drive customer retention and
growth.</span></p><p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0in;line-height:normal;"><b><i><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Roboto;color:#0183FF;"> </span></i></b></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0in;line-height:normal;"><b><i><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Roboto;color:#0183FF;">Key Responsibilities:</span></i></b></p><p><b><i></i></b></p><b><i></i></b><p class="MsoNormal" style="margin-bottom:0in;line-height:normal;border:none;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Roboto;color:#1F2431;"> </span></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpFirst" style="margin-top:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-bottom:0in;margin-left:0.75in;text-align:justify;text-indent:-0.25in;line-height:normal;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Symbol;">·<span style="font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-size:7pt;line-height:normal;font-family:'Times New Roman';">       </span></span><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Roboto;">Develop and execute customer success strategies
aligned with business goals, focused on retention, customer satisfaction,
adoption, renewal predictability, and growth.</span></p><p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-top:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-bottom:0in;margin-left:0.75in;text-align:justify;text-indent:-0.25in;line-height:normal;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Symbol;">·<span style="font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-size:7pt;line-height:normal;font-family:'Times New Roman';">   </span></span><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Roboto;">Streamline, automate, and scale customer success
processes across onboarding, implementation handover, adoption, renewals, churn
governance, and expansion motions.</span></p><p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-top:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-bottom:0in;margin-left:0.75in;text-align:justify;text-indent:-0.25in;line-height:normal;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Symbol;">·<span style="font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-size:7pt;line-height:normal;font-family:'Times New Roman';">    </span></span><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Roboto;">Own churn governance, including churn taxonomy,

signals, and intervention playbooks for at-risk accounts.</span></p><p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-top:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-bottom:0in;margin-left:0.75in;text-align:justify;text-indent:-0.25in;line-height:normal;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Symbol;">·<span style="font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-size:7pt;line-height:normal;font-family:'Times New Roman';">      </span></span><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Roboto;">Lead the design of customer health scorecards and
signal-based risk models using adoption, product usage, engagement, customer
health, and financial indicators to enable proactive CS intervention.</span></p><p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-top:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-bottom:0in;margin-left:0.75in;text-align:justify;text-indent:-0.25in;line-height:normal;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Symbol;">·<span style="font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-size:7pt;line-height:normal;font-family:'Times New Roman';">      </span></span><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Roboto;">Drive renewal process automation and system-led
governance to improve renewal visibility, tracking accuracy, accountability,
and execution discipline.</span></p><p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-top:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-bottom:0in;margin-left:0.75in;text-align:justify;text-indent:-0.25in;line-height:normal;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Symbol;">·<span style="font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-size:7pt;line-height:normal;font-family:'Times New Roman';">       </span></span><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Roboto;">Build data-driven expansion and upsell scoring
frameworks, including CSQL qualification, to enable systematic identification
and tracking of growth opportunities.</span></p><p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-top:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-bottom:0in;margin-left:0.75in;text-align:justify;text-indent:-0.25in;line-height:normal;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Symbol;">·<span style="font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-size:7pt;line-height:normal;font-family:'Times New Roman';">     </span></span><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Roboto;">Establish a structured Implementation-to-CS
handover process with defined checkpoints, documentation, ownership, and
account health status at the point of transition.</span></p><p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-top:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-bottom:0in;margin-left:0.75in;text-align:justify;text-indent:-0.25in;line-height:normal;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Symbol;">·<span style="font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-size:7pt;line-height:normal;font-family:'Times New Roman';">       </span></span><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Roboto;">Own configuration, workflow design, data

business requirements into scalable system processes.</span></p><p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-top:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-bottom:0in;margin-left:0.75in;text-align:justify;text-indent:-0.25in;line-height:normal;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Symbol;">·<span style="font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-size:7pt;line-height:normal;font-family:'Times New Roman';">     </span></span><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Roboto;">Build and maintain dashboards across churn,
renewals, customer health, adoption, NPS, and expansion pipeline, ensuring
accurate reporting for leadership reviews and business governance.</span></p><p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpMiddle" style="margin-top:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-bottom:0in;margin-left:0.75in;text-align:justify;text-indent:-0.25in;line-height:normal;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Symbol;">·<span style="font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-size:7pt;line-height:normal;font-family:'Times New Roman';">       </span></span><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Roboto;">Partner with Sales, Marketing, Product, Finance,
Implementation, and RevOps teams to capture customer feedback, improve customer
experience, and align CS initiatives with business priorities.</span></p><p></p><p class="MsoListParagraphCxSpLast" style="margin-top:0in;margin-right:0in;margin-bottom:0in;margin-left:0.75in;text-align:justify;text-indent:-0.25in;line-height:normal;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Symbol;">·<span style="font-style:normal;font-variant:normal;font-size:7pt;line-height:normal;font-family:'Times New Roman';">     </span></span><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Roboto;">Oversee customer onboarding and training programs

drive sustained adoption.</span></p><p></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;"><br /></p><p class="MsoNormal" style="text-align:justify;"><b><u><span style="font-size:12pt;line-height:107%;font-family:Roboto;color:rgb(1,131,255);background-size:initial;">Qualifications:</span></u></b></p><p><b><u></u></b></p><b><u></u></b><ul style="margin-top:0in;" type="disc">
 <li class="MsoNormal" style="color:#1F2431;margin-bottom:0in;line-height:normal;border:none;"><b><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Roboto;">Must-Have </span></b><p><b></b></p><b></b><ul style="margin-top:0in;" type="circle">
  <li class="MsoNormal" style="color:#1F2431;margin-bottom:0in;line-height:normal;border:none;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Roboto;">MBA/PGDM

  <li class="MsoNormal" style="color:#1F2431;margin-bottom:0in;line-height:normal;border:none;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Roboto;">Strong
      communication skills to present ideas, influence key stakeholders, and
      ensure successful process adoption across teams</span><p></p></li>
  <li class="MsoNormal" style="color:#1F2431;margin-bottom:0in;line-height:normal;border:none;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Roboto;">3+
      years of experience in leading process improvement initiatives in B2B
      SaaS industry, with the ability to drive organizational changes</span><p></p></li>
  <li class="MsoNormal" style="color:#1F2431;margin-bottom:0in;line-height:normal;border:none;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Roboto;">Previous
      experience in leading process improvement initiatives or teams, ideally
      in a cross-functional environment</span><p></p></li>
  <li class="MsoNormal" style="color:#1F2431;margin-bottom:0in;line-height:normal;border:none;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Roboto;">Expertise
      in using data analytics to inform decision-making, identify improvement
      opportunities, and track process performance through KPIs and metrics</span><p></p></li>
  <li class="MsoNormal" style="color:#1F2431;margin-bottom:0in;line-height:normal;border:none;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Roboto;">Hands-on experience on Gainsight</span><p></p></li>
  <li class="MsoNormal" style="color:#1F2431;margin-bottom:0in;line-height:normal;border:none;"><span style="font-size:12pt;font-family:Roboto;">Should
      possess strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to

 </ul><p></p>
